The '''European Championship''' (also '''European Championships''', '''EC''') is a Players Committee major event, usually held in September at Zu Den Vier Winden in Bochum, Germany. Some years have been elsewhere (Copenhagen 2024) or skipped (2020–2021 hiatus). Year pages list the field and decklists when this wiki has them.

How Swiss, ratings, and decklist sheets work: [[Tournaments]]. The chronological event index is [[List of SWCCG tournaments]]. Worlds hubs start at [[Championships]].
